cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I open the scholarship letter, make the tea properly. Warm the pot first—how many times did we practise that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made yours. Open it; I want to know if you're leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put sugar in. You always got eager and skipped the asking. I'll need another cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take mine. Are you frightened of going, or staying here with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give me yours and leave yourself nothing. Make a fresh one. Measure the leaves this time; I'll watch so you don't have to guess.

reason: Make old corrections and familiar pupil habits change A actual method. Preserve partner needs, causal contributions and exact Drive distinctions without using deliberate-test reversals.
